gloss: furoshiki bundle; something wrapped in a furoshiki cloth

definitions.gloss: furoshiki bundle; something wrapped in a furoshiki cloth
definitions.explanation: An item or items wrapped and carried in a furoshiki, a traditional Japanese wrapping cloth. The resulting bundle is a recognizable shape in Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {風呂敷包|ふろしきづつ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}っていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: She was carrying a furoshiki bundle in her hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{風呂敷包|ふろしきづつ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ってくる→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother always brings souvenirs wrapped in a furoshiki.

examples.japanese: {風呂敷包|ふろしきづつ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{解|ほど}く⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: When I unwrapped the furoshiki bundle, a beautiful kimono appeared from inside.

notes:
Refers to the bundle created by wrapping items in a ⟦{風呂敷|ふろしき}→風呂敷：05798_furoshiki⟧ (furoshiki), a square wrapping cloth. The ⟦{風呂敷|ふろしき}→風呂敷：05798_furoshiki⟧ itself is a versatile cloth used to wrap and carry all kinds of objects, from gifts to lunch boxes to bottles. In recent years, furoshiki wrapping has gained renewed attention as an eco-friendly alternative to disposable bags.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The image of someone carrying a {風呂敷包|ふろしきづつ}み is iconic in Japanese culture, associated with travelers, gift-giving, and traditional daily life. The expression ⟦{風呂敷|ふろしき}→風呂敷：05798_furoshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to spread a furoshiki) means to talk big or exaggerate.
